errors.evidence: This describes the range of the blue area plot's values, not the scale of the x-axis. The x-axis represents years from 2017 to 2023.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като „В трил. долара“
errors.evidence: The Y-axis itself is not labeled. The phrase 'В трил. долара' is part of the legend description for the blue data series, 'В2С пазар (в трлн. долара)'.

errors.text_span: На графиката са изобразени две линии. Първата линия е в син цвят, със стил плътна линия
errors.evidence: The chart consists of a blue area chart and an orange line chart, not two lines. Describing the blue area as a 'line' is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: простира се от стойност 1,00 през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The value for the B2C market in 2017 is 1.80 trillion dollars, not 1.00.

errors.evidence: The line representing growth ('Ръст') is orange, not red.

errors.text_span: Линията започва при 28% през 2017 г., достига 26% през 2018 г., 17% през 2019 г., 18% през 2020 г., 13% през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The percentage values are incorrectly mapped to the years. The growth of 28% corresponds to 2018 (not 2017), 26% to 2019 (not 2018), 17% to 2020 (correct), 18% to 2021 (correct), and 13% to 2022 (not 2021). There is no growth value shown for 2017.
The growth value for 2022 is 13%, not 5%.
